semantics: Represent comparable architecture layers or nodes, not arbitrary graph edges.
Use the shared toggle only when at least one node has details or expandedContent.
Keep product-specific architecture content in the consumer data.
accessibility: Decorative logo grouping remains aria-hidden; individual images use empty alt unless meaning is not otherwise present.
constraints: Do not use as a generic flowchart.
Do not encode product-specific node copy in the shared component.
Do not hard-code a consumer-specific column count; derive it from nodes.
verification: Render all expected nodes at desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Verify expansion control appears only when expandable content exists.
Verify image assets load where logos are supplied.
Run TypeScript and design-system registry validation.
responsive: Check 1440px, 768px, and 390px; no document overflow. Consumer-specific layout remains local.
use_when: A case study needs a compact system or runtime architecture with comparable nodes
Additional implementation details should be progressively disclosed
do_not_use_when: The content requires arbitrary graph topology or edge relationships
The diagram would need freeform canvas positioning
The content is only a decorative process illustration
